## Checklist

- [ ] Branch follows `<type>/<name>-<task>` and targets `dev`
- [ ] Code, comments and UI text in English
- [ ] No credentials, `.env` or `.netrc` (only `.env.example` with empty values)
- [ ] No large data files (download script instead)
- [ ] New NASA datasets / third-party code or assets credited in the README with links and licenses
- [ ] AI-generated files or blocks marked with a header comment
- [ ] Ran it locally; tests/linter pass (once set up)
- [ ] Anything judges open works without login
